components.name: Chain of Thought
components.summary: 思考链：展开检查步骤与详细内容。
notes: Use stable AIStep IDs so expansion survives streaming updates.

components.name: Chat
components.summary: 聊天：组合消息、输入框和宿主提交回调。
notes: Keep message IDs stable while streaming; mutate the existing reply. AIChat does not call a model service.

components.name: Checkpoint
components.summary: 检查点：恢复按钮与宿主回调。
notes: The host implements restoration; the component does not modify files.

components.name: Confirmation
components.summary: 审批：异步批准、拒绝与失败重试。
notes: For real approvals use submitDecision (async throws). A successful decision is not proof the underlying operation completed.

components.name: Context
components.summary: 上下文：显示 token 用量与容量。
notes: Counts come from the host; this view does not measure model usage.

components.name: File Tree
components.summary: 文件树：选择路径并控制展开状态。
notes: A node with children: nil is a file; children: [] is an empty folder. Keep iOS comfortable density for 44 pt targets.

components.name: Inline Citation
components.summary: 行内引用：正文中的来源胶囊与预览。
notes: Use AICitedText for citations inside wrapping prose; AIInlineCitation is a standalone control.

components.name: Message
components.summary: 消息：用户气泡、Markdown 和操作区。
notes: Use AIMessageText for user text and AIMessageResponse for Markdown. Place actions in footer, outside the bubble.

components.name: Model Selector
components.summary: 模型选择：模型分组与推理强度。
notes: Model identifiers are host configuration, not built-in provider integrations.

components.name: Plan
components.summary: 计划：展示步骤状态与完成数。
notes: Maintain stable step IDs; isExpanded can be controlled by the host.

components.name: Prompt Input
components.summary: 输入框：草稿、附件、发送和停止回调。
notes: Clear draft and increment attachmentResetID only after the host accepts submission. onStop should cancel the host task.

components.name: Queue
components.summary: 队列：待办、运行中与已完成分组。
notes: onSelect is a host callback; AIQueue is not a scheduler.

components.name: Reasoning
components.summary: 推理：展示流式内容与思考用时。
notes: Text is verbatim by default; opt into rendersMarkdown when appropriate. Use provider-visible summaries, not hidden chain-of-thought.

components.name: Sources
components.summary: 来源：展开来源列表与外部链接。
notes: Empty sources are hidden unless showsEmptyState is true. Host supplies source metadata.

components.name: Stack Trace
components.summary: 错误栈：错误展开与源码定位回调。
notes: onOpenFrame passes parsed metadata; the host chooses how to navigate to source. Keep iOS 44 pt targets.

components.name: Subagent
components.summary: 子任务：嵌套执行轨迹与结果。
notes: This renders a subtask; it does not spawn an AI agent.

components.name: Suggestion
components.summary: 建议：横向可点选的提示词。
notes: Use onSelect to fill a draft or dispatch a host action.

components.name: Task
components.summary: 任务：折叠步骤、运行与失败状态。
notes: Status may be inferred from steps or explicitly provided by the host.

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: 终端：命令、输出与退出码状态。
notes: The command string is display-only. Nonzero exitCode presents failure. Execution belongs to the host.

components.name: Test Results
components.summary: 测试结果：测试套件、失败详情与跳过状态。
notes: For startup use suites: [], isRunning: true. commandError describes a failure to launch tests.

components.name: Tool
components.summary: 工具：调用输入、输出与执行状态。
notes: Use AIToolPhase for provider-neutral state mapping. The view never runs a command or tool.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: 纵向布局：按间距组合子节点。
notes: Protocol layout node, rendered by AIUIRenderer; there is no AIStack constructor. gap is 0...48 pt.
Run aielements ui example stack for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.
The upstream link is a layout/text reference, not a same-named shadcn component.

components.name: Row
components.summary: 横向布局：空间不足时回退为纵向。
notes: Protocol layout node, rendered by AIUIRenderer; horizontal layout falls back to a vertical stack when needed, not a wrapping flow layout.
Run aielements ui example row for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.
The upstream link is a layout/text reference, not a same-named shadcn component.

components.name: Card
components.summary: 卡片：基础与图表样式、标题和页脚。
notes: Use style standard (16 pt insets) for base cards and chart for chart-gallery cards. Native headerAction/footerContent slots are not JSON properties.
Run aielements ui example card for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Text
components.summary: 文字：正文、标题、弱化、说明与标签。
notes: Protocol Text is rendered by AIUIRenderer; variants are body/title/muted/caption/label. Do not invent an AIText constructor.
Run aielements ui example text for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.
The upstream link is a layout/text reference, not a same-named shadcn component.

components.name: Button
components.summary: 按钮：五种外观与宿主操作回调。
notes: Native Button uses AIFoundationButtonStyle. Protocol Button needs events.press and an AIUIRenderer onEvent callback to be enabled. Preserve iOS comfortable density.
Run aielements ui example button for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: 徽章：主色、次要、描边、透明与危险状态。
notes: Protocol Badge has five foundation variants; the existing AIBadge helper is a different API and is not a drop-in variant selector.
Run aielements ui example badge for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Input
components.summary: 输入：绑定草稿与变更事件。
notes: Native AIInput uses a Binding<String>; protocol Input needs bindings.value and an initial state key to be editable. secure and labelAccessory are native-only slots.
Run aielements ui example input for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Select
components.summary: 选择器：占位文字、选项与状态绑定。
notes: Use placeholder for an empty selection; options use id in Swift and value in JSON. Protocol editing requires bindings.value and initialized state. Menus are native.
Run aielements ui example select for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: 开关：布尔状态与变更回调。
notes: Native AISwitch uses Binding<Bool>; protocol Switch requires a boolean state binding. Keep the iOS outer hit target at 44 pt.
Run aielements ui example switch for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: 进度：数值、总量与浅深色轨道。
notes: Native API uses total; JSON uses max. Keep max positive; the default is 100. Dark fill follows the primary theme color.
Run aielements ui example progress for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: 分隔线：主题边框色的横线。
notes: Protocol Separator is a horizontal 1 pt theme-border line. It has no orientation property or standalone AISeparator constructor.
Run aielements ui example separator for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Table
components.summary: 表格：列宽、对齐、强调、合计与说明。
notes: Column alignment is leading/trailing, preferred width 24...600; row/footer keys match column keys. Caption sits below the table.
Run aielements ui example table for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Bar Chart
components.summary: 柱状图：多序列数据与选择回调。
notes: Use AIChart(.bar). Protocol series keys map to numeric data values; row labels must be unique. Up to 5 series and 200 rows; no stacked variant.
Run aielements ui example bar-chart for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Line Chart
components.summary: 折线图：自然三次曲线与选择回调。
notes: Use AIChart(.line) with natural cubic curves. Stable unique row labels preserve selection; up to 5 series and 200 rows.
Run aielements ui example line-chart for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Area Chart
components.summary: 面积图：自然曲线、40% 填充与选择回调。
notes: Use AIChart(.area) with natural curves and solid fill at 40% opacity. No gradient, stacked, pie, radar, or zoom variant is provided.
Run aielements ui example area-chart for complete JSON; see Documentation/StreamingUI.md for properties, bindings, events and lifecycle.

components.name: Streaming UI
components.summary: 流式界面：逐段接收 JSONL，保留输入并回传宿主操作。
notes: Independent JSONL protocol, not OpenAI/A2UI wire compatibility. Read Documentation/StreamingUI.md.
Use one store per surface on MainActor. receive bytes incrementally, finish at EOF, interrupt on cancellation/failure, reset before a fresh begin.
Whole-node updates replace events/bindings too. Do not overwrite user drafts with repeated initial state.
Run aielements ui stream for JSONL; aielements ui validate file.jsonl requires a complete successful stream. SSE data payloads must be decoded before apply; raw SSE is not JSONL.
